decisions.reason: The healthcare and hospitality recruitment service is far from the core and its value is still unproven after one year, but a recruitment service built on the existing crewing infrastructure costs little to keep, so the option is worth holding a while longer despite the elevated risk of pruning.

Superyacht crew recruitment draws directly on the firm's crewing network and seafarer pool, costs little to maintain, and its uncertainty has not resolved negatively, so keeping the option is clearly justified.
